author: Jobs.com
title: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote
content:
HIRING!

Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist

Fully Remote

https://work.turing.com/r/BpA6o2F8Jm

Role Overview

We are looking for talented Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists who can create high-quality artwork from reference images while introducing creative variations and maintaining the character’s identity.

This opportunity is open to interns, freshers, emerging artists, and experienced professionals with strong visual skills and a portfolio that demonstrates creativity, versatility, and attention to detail.

What You’ll Do

1. Create digital character illustrations and sketches using provided reference images.

2. Produce creative variations while maintaining character identity and visual consistency.

3. Apply core fundamentals of composition, color, lighting, perspective, and proportion.

4. Adapt artwork across diverse visual themes based on project requirements.

5. Document creative decisions, style choices, and simple prompt metadata.

6. Deliver polished, high-quality artwork within assigned project timelines.

Contact/apply: https://work.turing.com/r/BpA6o2F8Jm

title: Calling all artists: get paid to create art for a frontier AI project
content:
Calling all artists: get paid to create art for a frontier AI project!

Turing, one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, is looking for Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists to join a remote project.

What you’ll do:
Create digital character illustrations and sketches from reference images
Produce creative variations while keeping the character’s identity consistent
Apply strong fundamentals: composition, color, lighting, perspective, and proportion
Work across styles like surreal, cinematic, vintage, retro, steampunk, and glitch art
Document your creative decisions and style choices

What you’ll need:
A strong portfolio showing creativity, versatility, and attention to detail
Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, Procreate, Clip Studio Paint, Affinity, or similar tools
The ability to work independently and meet timelines

The details:
Fully remote
Paid in USD
10-12 weeks, with flexible hours (up to 40/week, or part-time up to 20/week)
Starts after onboarding and portfolio approval

Apply here and submit your portfolio: https://work.turing.com/r/Z8WK4lG5Jy
